svg.aria-label: Sixty updates on F=(x²+25y²)/2, starting at (3,1). SGD and momentum use rate 0.07, momentum coefficient 0.6; Adam uses 0.15. Stars mark the minimizer and gray contours share levels. These are controlled update-rule experiments on an analytic objective.
